description: This file contains an interrupt service routine (ISR) written in ARM assembly language for the AT91RM9200 microcontroller. It defines the handler for the MCI (MultiMedia Card Interface) interrupt, including context saving/restoring, interrupt handling, and mode switching.

methods.name: AT91F_ASM_MCI_Handler
methods.description: Assembly routine serving as the interrupt handler for the MCI interface, handling context saving, interrupt processing, and context restoring for ARM architecture on the AT91RM9200.
